title: Roadside Checkpoint Encounter
setup_text: An authoritative road safety patrol stops your movement along the transit corridor, demanding to review compliance and conduct a strict routine inspection.

options.label: Greet respectfully and explain your business

on_success.text: Your respectful greetings and warm courtesies win them over. The officer smiles, waves you on, and wishes you good sales!

on_fail.text: Your stuttered explanation sounds suspicious. They search your belongings thoroughly, wasting valuable daylight.

options.label: Present valid permits and trade clearance

on_success.text: Your papers are stamped and in order. The inspector nods curtly and gives you immediate clearance.

on_fail.text: One photocopy has a folded smudge. You spend twenty minutes explaining yourself in the scorching sun.

options.label: Stand patiently and comply with all instructions

on_success.text: You wait out the slow inspection quietly. No issues found, though you lose some energy in the process.

title: Filling Station Queue Scramble
setup_text: Rumours of a fuel scarcity tanker delay trigger a sudden 50-vehicle scramble outside the filling station. Jerry cans and kekes crowd the pump entrance.

options.label: Hold your queue position with pure determination

on_success.text: You refuse to be shoved aside. You reach the pump nozzle first and secure your purchase at standard pump price!

on_fail.text: Aggressive touts push ahead in the confusion, leaving you stranded with empty jerry cans and aching shoulders.

options.label: Wave down the attendant with sharp street diplomacy

on_success.text: You whisper a sharp tip promise to the pump attendant, who quietly waves you into the VIP bay.

on_fail.text: The manager catches the move and barks at the attendant to serve the queue in strict order.

title: Sudden Canopy Leak in the Market
setup_text: A sudden torrential cloudburst unleashes heavy rain. Water pools on top of your plastic tarpaulin, threatening to collapse onto your goods and customers.

options.label: Scramble up with a bamboo pole to reinforce the canopy

on_success.text: You prop up the sag and drain the pool harmlessly into the drainage gutter! Your goods and customers stay bone dry.

on_fail.text: A gust of wind catches the pole! Cold gutter water splashes your face and dampens your merchandise.

options.label: Pack essential merchandise into waterproof plastic sacks

on_success.text: Fast hands save every single item before the first drop touches them. Other stall owners applaud your speed.

on_fail.text: You trip over a crate in the scramble. The sacks tear, spoiling some packaging.

title: Slick Fingers in the Crowd
setup_text: In the dense crowd pushing past the pedestrian crossing, your sharp eyes catch a youth's hand slipping towards a mother's wrapped handbag.

options.label: Raise a loud, timely shout to alert the crowd

on_success.text: "Madam, hold your bag well!" you shout. The startled pickpocket pulls back his hand and melts into the crowd.

on_fail.text: You shout too late. The culprit darts between two parked danfos and disappears.

options.label: Deliberately bump the suspect to foil the attempt

on_success.text: You step into the youth's path with a firm shoulder. He glares at you, realizes you caught him, and backs away quickly.

on_fail.text: The youth's associate nudges you aggressively from behind with harsh words, creating an uncomfortable scene.

title: Landlord's Street Rampage
setup_text: An irate landlord with a walking stick is shouting outside your building compound, threatening to lock the main security gate over unpaid sanitation dues.

options.label: Offer elder greetings and soothe his temper

on_success.text: You address him as 'Baba', listen to his complaints patiently, and promise to rally the tenants. He calms down and unlocks the gate.

on_fail.text: Your words seem to annoy him further. He rants about undisciplined youths before stomping off.

options.label: Organize tenants on the spot to clear the dues

on_success.text: You collect small contributions from neighbours on the spot and settle the bill cleanly. Everyone hails you as a responsible leader.

on_fail.text: Two stubborn neighbours refuse to contribute their share, leaving you to cover an embarrassing shortfall.

title: Loading Bay Deadlock
setup_text: Two stubborn commercial drivers lock bumpers at the narrow exit lane. Neither driver agrees to reverse, backing up a queue of twenty honking vehicles.

options.label: Step into the road and direct the reverse flow

on_success.text: With clear hand signals and commanding authority, you guide both buses out smoothly. The entire queue cheers as the gridlock melts!

on_fail.text: One conductor insults your hand directions. Both drivers refuse to move until union touts arrive with canes.

options.label: Alert the park chairman's enforcement boys

on_success.text: The park enforcers arrive within two minutes. At first sight of them, both drivers reverse instantly and clear the road.

on_fail.text: The enforcers take their sweet time arriving, leaving you stuck inhaling exhaust fumes for forty minutes.

title: Suspicious Electronic Transfer
setup_text: A flashily dressed customer shows an SMS notification on his smartphone claiming a ₦15,000 transfer, pressuring you to release items immediately.

options.label: Insist on checking your personal banking app balance first

on_success.text: Your banking app shows zero incoming funds. You calmly point it out; the customer mumbles an excuse and hurries away!

on_fail.text: Poor telecom network delays your banking app. The customer creates a scene before you finally spot the fake sender header.

options.label: Demand hard cash or a physical POS slip

on_success.text: You refuse to budge on payment policy. Realizing you cannot be tricked, the customer sheepishly hands over real banknotes.

on_fail.text: The customer loudly curses your business and stalks off, taking his money elsewhere.

title: Sanitation Task Force Inspection
setup_text: A municipal sanitation inspector in yellow overalls points a clipboard at paper refuse blown by the wind in front of your spot, threatening a penalty.

options.label: Explain the windblown litter with friendly local banter

on_success.text: You sweep the paper into a bin right in front of him with a smile. The inspector appreciates your prompt civic attitude.

on_fail.text: The inspector takes your words as disrespect and writes an official warning citation.

options.label: Grab a broom and sweep the whole gutter edge clean

on_success.text: Your fast broom work leaves the frontage gleaming. Nearby vendors praise your standard of cleanliness.

on_fail.text: Dust enters your eyes and nose, leaving you coughing while the inspector frowns.

title: High Voltage Surge at Dusk
setup_text: A chorus of 'Up NEPA!' erupts as electricity returns, but the street transformer sparks loudly with dangerously high voltage.

options.label: Sprint to disconnect your breaker switch immediately

on_success.text: You flick off the changeover switch seconds before a power surge pops bulbs across the street. All appliances saved!

on_fail.text: You reach the board just as a small surge blows your extension box fuse with a sharp crack.

options.label: Shout warnings to alert neighbouring shops and rooms

on_success.text: Your urgent shouts alert twenty people who cut their power in time. Neighbours thank you profusely with warm greetings.

on_fail.text: Your shouts are drowned out by the roar of generators that haven't been turned off yet.

title: Confused Traveler at the Interchange
setup_text: An elderly passenger holding a heavy traveling box looks utterly bewildered by the sprawling multi-terminal overhead ramps and bus numbers.

options.label: Patiently explain the exact terminal bay and bus route

on_success.text: Your clear instructions guide him straight to the right ticket booth. He blesses your hustle with heartfelt gratitude.

on_fail.text: You accidentally mix up Terminal 2 with Terminal 3, sending him up the wrong escalator before having to run after him.

options.label: Help carry his heavy box directly to his departure bay

on_success.text: You haul the luggage safely through the pedestrian gates. Overjoyed by your kindness, the passenger presses a ₦2,000 tip into your hand!

on_fail.text: The heavy box strains your back on the concrete stairs. The traveler thanks you warmly, but you feel the ache.

title: Tomato Basket Price War
setup_text: A vocal wholesale customer claims your basket of fresh plum tomatoes is far too expensive, pointing aggressively to an inferior basket down the line.

options.label: Hold your price and showcase superior fresh quality

on_success.text: You slice open one tomato to prove its dense, firm flesh. The buyer acknowledges the quality and pays your full asking price!

on_fail.text: The buyer laughs mockingly and walks down the alley, leaving you with unsold perishable stock.

options.label: Bundle with peppers and onions for an irresistible combo

on_success.text: The combo deal moves two extra baskets of peppers at high margin! Both parties walk away grinning.

on_fail.text: You calculate the bundle margin too tightly and barely break even on the transaction.

title: Depot Clearance Lot
setup_text: A depot freight driver needs to return to Ogun State and offers you three sealed cartons of premium phone accessories at half standard cost if taken immediately.

options.label: Bargain aggressively for the entire lot on cash terms

on_success.text: You negotiate a jaw-dropping deal and snap up the inventory. Your expected retail profit margin exceeds 200%!

on_fail.text: You hesitate on the price; a rival merchant steps in with cash and buys the lot right out from under you.

options.label: Carefully inspect samples for counterfeit seals

on_success.text: Your keen eye confirms the hologram seals are 100% genuine original factory goods. You buy with supreme confidence.

on_fail.text: The driver grows impatient while you squint at serial numbers and drives off to another market.

title: The Never-Ending Bargain
setup_text: A well-dressed woman has spent twenty-five minutes examining a single silk wrapper, offering barely 40% of its cost price while blocking other shoppers.

options.label: Flatter her elegance and style to seal the deal

on_success.text: You explain how perfectly the cloth complements her status. She beams with pride and happily pays full value!

on_fail.text: She sees right through the flattery and folds her arms stubbornly, wasting another ten minutes.

options.label: Politely fold the fabric and attend to the next customer

on_success.text: Realizing you won't be bullied on price, she quickly reaches into her purse and agrees to your previous offer.

on_fail.text: She clicks her tongue loudly, makes a dramatic comment about your attitude, and walks away.

title: Frontage Line Encroachment
setup_text: An aggressive hawker sets up a large wooden display table overlapping two feet into your assigned market stall frontage, blocking customer views.

options.label: Negotiate a fair cooperative compromise

on_success.text: You propose angling both tables so both vendors gain wider visibility. Both of you enjoy booming foot traffic!

on_fail.text: He shouts that the street belongs to the government, attracting an unruly crowd of onlookers.

options.label: Produce your official stall allocation ticket

on_success.text: You flash your official union receipt. A nearby market elder nods and orders the intruder to pull his table back.

on_fail.text: He claims your receipt is from last quarter. You have to call the union secretary to settle the dispute.

title: Crisp Paper Mystery
setup_text: A customer hands you two crisp ₦1,000 notes for bulk provisions. The paper feels unusually smooth and the watermark looks slightly off-center.

options.label: Discreetly test the ink texture and security thread

on_success.text: Your fingers immediately detect the fake raised ink. You quietly return it; the embarrassed buyer swaps it for authentic notes.

on_fail.text: You hesitate too long. The customer snatches the provisions and melts into the crowded evening rush.

options.label: Hold the note up to the sunlight and challenge the authenticity

on_success.text: You expose the absence of the silver thread in broad daylight. Nearby traders surround the fraudster until valid money is produced.

on_fail.text: The customer vehemently accuses you of trying to defame him, creating an uncomfortable market shouting match.

title: Blowout on the Expressway
setup_text: A sudden loud pop shakes your vehicle! Your front right tyre goes completely flat in the middle of a packed highway transit run.

options.label: Whip out the hydraulic jack and swap the spare in record time

on_success.text: You change the wheel in under eight minutes flat! Impressed passengers stay aboard and tip you for rapid rescue.

on_fail.text: A rusted wheel nut refuses to turn! Passengers grow frustrated, demand fare refunds, and board another bus.

options.label: Limp slowly into a nearby roadside vulcanizer bay

on_success.text: The vulcanizer patches the puncture with burning rubber in ten minutes for a fair fee. You rejoin the route promptly.

on_fail.text: The vulcanizer's compressor has no power! You waste thirty minutes waiting for him to pull his generator cord.

title: Big Money, Small Fare
setup_text: A commuter hands you a crisp high-denomination banknote for a short ₦200 hop, claiming with a shrug that he has zero smaller denominations.

options.label: Cleverly pair him with other passengers needing change

on_success.text: You orchestrate a quick change exchange between three passengers before the next stop. Every fare accounted for!

on_fail.text: The math gets muddled, creating a noisy argument inside the bus that slows down your route.

options.label: Demand he buy cold pure water from a hawker to break the note

on_success.text: The passenger leans out the window, buys two sachets of pure water, and hands you the exact change with a laugh.

on_fail.text: The passenger stubbornly refuses and causes an argument at the bus door.

title: Aggressive Park Ticket Agbero
setup_text: An aggressive park tout grabs hold of your side mirror, violently demanding an unauthorized afternoon 'loading development ticket'.

options.label: Slap his hand away from the mirror and assert park seniority

on_success.text: You lock eyes with him and bark his senior union boss's name. Realizing you know the hierarchy, he lets go and scuttles away.

on_fail.text: He whistles for his crew, kicking your wheel rim and demanding double payment before letting you leave.

options.label: Calm him down with smooth street greeting and minor tip

on_success.text: You hand him a small ₦200 tip with a warm fist bump. He salutes you as 'Chairman' and clears the way.

on_fail.text: He insults your small tip and demands full ticket money anyway.

title: Unpaved Alleyway Bypass
setup_text: The main artery is deadlocked by a broken-down oil tanker. Impatient passengers urge you to take a narrow unpaved residential alleyway shortcut.

options.label: Masterfully maneuver the craters and drainage ditches

on_success.text: You glide across the backstreets with precision, bypassing two kilometres of gridlock! Passengers cheer and tip generously.

on_fail.text: Your undercarriage scrapes heavily against a raised drainage slab with a sickening crunch.

options.label: Stay firmly on the paved highway and ride out the jam

on_success.text: The tanker is towed ten minutes later. You safely stay on smooth asphalt with zero vehicle damage.

on_fail.text: The jam drags on for an hour. Impatient passengers grumble continuously about your lack of adventure.

title: Steam Rising on the Bridge Climb
setup_text: Ascending the steep bridge incline in hot afternoon traffic, thick white steam suddenly hisses from under the passenger bench—the radiator is boiling!

options.label: Carefully nurse the throttle to crest the bridge safely

on_success.text: With delicate throttle control, you crest the bridge and coast safely into an emergency lay-by without blowing the head gasket!

on_fail.text: The engine cuts out on the incline with a loud wheeze, forcing passengers to help push you to the side.

options.label: Hail pure-water sellers to cool the radiator immediately

on_success.text: You buy four bags of ice-cold pure water, carefully pour them over the core, and restore normal temperature in minutes.

on_fail.text: You open the cap a second too soon! Steam scalds your thumb and wastes the water.
